verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is an equity-management SaaS, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence describes only click-through workflows (buttons, guided forms, bulk uploads) and a Gusto integration, with no natural-language, chat, or AI-assistant capability. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so there is also no evidence of a machine-readable surface an AI tool could drive.
